technical.summary: Long-term structure bullish but short-term momentum severely compromised by death cross, weak RSI, and bearish MACD; oversold conditions with rising RSI suggest potential bounce but lack confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: AMP shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 40 days—fundamental signals are absent across all smart money indicators.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals with congressional activity showing minor sales by junior Democrats, broad market fear (38/100) presenting potential contrarian opportunity, but insufficient conviction and no news data to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with inverted yield curve, crisis-level VIX (240+), and recent FOMC event creating hostile environment for financials; earnings in 40 days adds execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term structure (EMA 50/200 and SMA 50/200 bullish, supertrend bullish) with oversold RSI conditions and broad market fear (38/100) create potential contrarian bounce opportunity near support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical short-term momentum collapse (EMA 9/21 death cross, MACD bearish, AO cross down, price below both EMA 9 and 21) combined with crisis-level macro environment (VIX 240+, inverted yield curve, high credit spreads) and zero fundamental conviction make this a high-risk, low-probability entry.
